# Glympse Core SDK for iOS: API outline (llms-full.txt)

Companion to AGENTS.md. This is an outline of the public API surface of the GlympseKit (Objective-C) framework for the
core platform. Selectors are the ObjC names; Swift imports them with the usual renaming (`sendTicket:` -> `send(_:)`,
`exemptFromConsent:` -> `exempt(fromConsent:)`, `addInvite:` -> `add(_:)`, `createGlympseWithNSString:withNSString:` ->
`createGlympse(with:with:)`, `decodeInviteWithNSString:withInt:` -> `decodeInvite(with:with:)`; `getX` stays `getX()`).
Verify exact signatures in the framework headers before relying on an item here. Not covered: groups, cards, POIs,
triggers, place search, chat, customer pickups, linked accounts, directions/route planning, map and UI controls.

Constants are class methods. Swift lowercases the text before the first underscore and keeps the rest:
`GlyGlympseEvents.platform_STARTED()`, `GlyGlympseConstants.invite_TYPE_LINK()`, `GlyCoreConstants.location_PERMISSION_ALWAYS()`.
In ObjC they are `[GlyGlympseEvents PLATFORM_STARTED]`. Below, names are written without the class prefix.

## 0. Module
- GlympseKit: GlyGlympseFactory, GlyGlympse, GlyConfig, GlyConsentManager, GlyUserManager, GlyUser, GlyUserTicket,
  GlyHistoryManager, GlyTicket, GlyInvite, GlyPlace, GlyLocationManager, GlyNetworkManager, GlyBatteryManager,
  GlyEventListener, GlyEventSink, GlyImage, GlyTrack, GlyArray<T>, GlyPrimitive, GlyCommon, GlyGlympseConstants,
  GlyGlympseEvents, GlyCoreConstants. Import only `GlympseKit`

## 1. Install
- Swift Package Manager: https://github.com/Glympse/glympse-ios-sdk-release, product `GlympseKit`. Package minimum iOS 12.
  Use the latest release

## 2. GlyGlympseFactory (class methods)
- createGlympseWithNSString:withNSString: (server, apiKey) -> GlyGlympse (a prefix overload exists)
- createTicket:message:destination: (durationMs, message?, GlyPlace?) -> GlyTicket
- createInviteWithInt:withNSString:withNSString: (type, name?, address) -> GlyInvite; a variant takes a subtype;
  createPublicInvite:
- createRequest:invite:; createPlace:longitude:name:; createAddress:...; createImage:
- createTrackBuilder; account profile helpers (createPhoneAccountProfile:, createEmailAccountProfile:, ...)
- Never implement model protocols yourself; obtain them from here or from the platform

## 3. GlyGlympse (a GlyEventSink: add / remove listener)
Lifecycle and account:
- start: once per instance. Silently returns if server or API key is empty. Fires PLATFORM_STARTED synchronously
- stop: posts to the main thread if needed; never call from inside eventsOccurred. Instance dead afterwards
- isStarted, isFirstLaunch (valid right after creation; resets after logout), hasUserAccount
- logout -> BOOL: NO while started. Wipes account, nickname, avatar, history, consent; next start creates a new account
- login: (GlyPrimitive profile): before first start only; recovers an existing account; ignored if an account exists.
  confirmAccount:profile: sends a confirmation code, returns a sink
- setActive: (BOOL) -> int: reference counted; returns the count. start resets it to 0. isActive
- getAccessToken: short-lived; query each time; nil until PLATFORM_LOGIN_SUCCEEDED
- getTime: server time in ms. getApiVersion: "major.minor.build"
Configuration BEFORE start (none persisted): setHandler:, setSmsSendMode:, enableSmsScraping: (Android only feature),
setEtaMode: (ETA_MODE_EXTERNAL default | INTERNAL), setRestoreHistory: (default NO), setHistoryLookback:(ms),
allowSiblingTickets: (default NO), enableInviteViewersTracking:, setBrand: (subcategory of the API key for invite branding)
Managers (most are nil before start): getConfig and getConsentManager work before start. After start: getUserManager,
getHistoryManager, getLocationManager, getNetworkManager, getBatteryManager, getDirectionsManager, getGroupManager,
getCardManager, getPoiManager, ...
Invites: decodeInviteWithNSString:withInt: (code, mode) and a variant with an invite -> GlyEventSink;
openUrl:mode:invite: -> BOOL; extractInviteCodes: and getInviteAspect: are thread-safe; cleanupInviteCode:,
compareInviteCodes:code2:; viewTicket: (GlyUserTicket) -> GlyTicket?
Tickets: sendTicket: -> BOOL; requestTicket:
Push: registerDeviceTokenWithNSString: (token; default type apple_background) / registerDeviceTokenWithNSString:withNSString:
(type, token); both are ignored until started. unregisterDeviceToken, hasValidDeviceToken,
handleRemoteNotificationWithNSString: (payload; ignored until started)
Debug: verify, overrideLoggingLevels:debugLevel:, setLogReceiver:, showDebugView

## 4. GlyConsentManager (available before start)
- hasConsent, getConsentState (USER_CONSENT_NONE / NO / YES / EXEMPT strings)
- exemptFromConsent:(BOOL): before start; not persisted
- grantConsent:partnerId: (CONSENT_TYPE_SUBJECT() | CONSENT_TYPE_GUARDIAN(), partnerId >= 0): starts account creation if none
- revokeConsent:(partnerId)
- Events (LISTENER_CONSENT): CONSENT_REQUIRED, CONSENT_SUCCEEDED, CONSENT_FAILED, CONSENT_REVOKE_SUCCEEDED,
  CONSENT_REVOKE_FAILED, CONSENT_MANAGER_SYNCED, CONSENT_MANAGER_SYNC_FAILED
- Constants: PRIVACY_POLICY_URL(), TERMS_AND_CONDITIONS_URL(); agreement text key glympse_gdpr_message (glympse_api.strings)

## 5. Events (GlyEventListener eventsOccurred:listener:events:object:)
`listener` is one of the LISTENER_* values; `events` is a bitmask. Constants live in GlyGlympseEvents. `object` is a
GlyCommon: cast with `as?` to GlyUser, GlyTicket, GlyUserTicket, NSString, ...
LISTENER_PLATFORM (=1), on the platform
- PLATFORM_STARTED, PLATFORM_FIRST_LAUNCH (only the very first start, and again after logout), PLATFORM_STOPPED
- PLATFORM_ACCOUNT_CREATED (new anonymous account), PLATFORM_ACCOUNT_CREATE_FAILED (fatal: platform stops)
- PLATFORM_LOGIN_SUCCEEDED (every start), PLATFORM_LOGIN_FAILED (fatal), PLATFORM_SESSION_FAILED (token expired; SDK
  re-authenticates by itself)
- PLATFORM_SYNCED_WITH_SERVER (once per instance), PLATFORM_TICKET_SYNC_COMPLETED (after every ticket sync)
- PLATFORM_USER_ADDED / _REMOVED / _CHANGED / _LIST_REORDERED (object: GlyUser); PLATFORM_LOCATION
- PLATFORM_TICKET_ADDED / _REMOVED / _CHANGED / _LIST_REORDERED / PLATFORM_TICKET_ARRIVED (object: GlyTicket)
- PLATFORM_INVITE_TICKET, PLATFORM_INVITE_REQUEST (object: GlyUserTicket)
- PLATFORM_RATE_LIMITED (server said "rate_limited"; the request is not retried), PLATFORM_STATE_CHANGED (foreground/background change)
LISTENER_INVITE (=2), on the sink returned by decodeInvite
- INVITE_DECODED, INVITE_INVALID_CODE (object: the invite code string)
LISTENER_USER (=3), on a GlyUser
- USER_NICKNAME_CHANGED, USER_ACTIVE_TICKET_CHANGED, USER_ACTIVE_TICKET_RESIGNING (old active ticket still readable),
  USER_TICKET_ADDED, USER_TICKET_REMOVED (object: GlyTicket), USER_AVATAR_UPLOADED, USER_AVATAR_NOT_UPLOADED
LISTENER_TICKET (=4), on a GlyTicket (not fired for expired or sibling tickets, except TICKET_TRANSFERRED)
- TICKET_CREATED (invite codes not assigned yet), TICKET_FAILED, TICKET_EXPIRED, TICKET_COMPLETED
- TICKET_INVITE_CREATED (client-delivered invites), TICKET_INVITE_SENT (server-delivered), TICKET_INVITE_UPDATED (viewers,
  fired periodically while watched), TICKET_INVITE_REMOVED, TICKET_INVITE_FAILED
- TICKET_REQUEST_CREATED / _SENT / _FAILED
- TICKET_FIRST_VIEWED, TICKET_INVALID_CODE, TICKET_ARRIVED
- TICKET_DURATION_CHANGED, _MESSAGE_CHANGED, _DESTINATION_CHANGED, _TRACK_CHANGED, _ETA_CHANGED, _ROUTE_CHANGED,
  _TRAVEL_MODE_CHANGED, _VISIBILITY_CHANGED
- TICKET_DATA_APPENDED / _DATA_CLEARED (custom properties), TICKET_TRANSFERRED / _NOT_TRANSFERRED
LISTENER_NETWORK (=5): NETWORK_START_FAILING, NETWORK_RECOVERED, NETWORK_PUSH_AVAILABILITY_CHANGED, ...
LISTENER_BATTERY (=6): BATTERY_STATE_CHANGED. LISTENER_IMAGE (=7): IMAGE_CHANGED.
LISTENER_LOCATION (=8): LOCATION_STATE_CHANGED, LOCATION_ACCURACY_AUTH_CHANGED. LISTENER_CONSENT (=28): see section 4.

## 6. Users and history
- GlyUserManager: getSelf, getUsers (index 0 is self), getStandaloneUsers, findUserByUserId:, findUserByInviteCode:,
  findTicketByInviteCode:, startTracking: / stopTracking: (reference counted; start returns the count, -1 if the user is
  unknown or self), startTrackingAll, stopTrackingAll:, getTracking, anyActiveTracked, setUserTrackingMode:
  (USER_TRACKING_MODE_ACTIVE default | ALL), enablePersistence: (default on)
- GlyUser: getId, isSelf, getNickname / setNickname:, getAvatar (GlyImage) / setAvatar: (GlyDrawable), getLocation,
  getActive (GlyTicket), getActiveStandalone, getTickets, findTicketByInviteCode:, stopWatching. Avatars never download
  automatically: call load on the image and wait for IMAGE_CHANGED
- GlyUserTicket (from PLATFORM_INVITE_TICKET/REQUEST): getUser, getTicket, getInvite
- GlyHistoryManager (your outgoing tickets): isSynced, getTickets, anyActive, refresh, findTicketByTicketId:,
  findTicketByInviteCode:, enableCancellationTimer: (default off) + setCancellationTimeout:(ms) (stop retrying ticket
  creation during a long network outage; by default creation is retried until it succeeds)

## 7. Tickets and invites
- GlyTicket: getId, getCode, getState (TICKET_STATE_*), isMine, isSibling, isActive (own active tickets only),
  isCompleted, getUser, getInvites, getDuration, getStartTime, getExpireTime, getMessage, getDestination (GlyPlace),
  getTrack, getEta, getRoute, getTravelMode, isWatching, isSomeoneWatching
  Mutators (sent tickets): modify:message:destination:, clear:destination:, extend:, expire (same as modify with 0),
  addInvite:, deleteInvite:, canAddInvite:, own (take over a sibling ticket)
  Custom data: appendData:name:value: (after TICKET_CREATED), getProperty:name:, getPropertyData:name:,
  getPartnerData:
  Request tickets: setRequestEndTime:, getRequestTicket, setRequestNoReply:
- GlyInvite: getType, getName, getAddress, getCode, getUrl (set once the invite exists), getState (INVITE_STATE_*),
  getCreatedTime, getLastViewTime, getViewers, getViewing, getText (server-formatted message), getError, setVisible:,
  setCreateOnly:, setRequestTicket:, initiateClientSideSend, completeClientSideSend:
- Invite name/address by type: SMS (name optional; phone number required), EMAIL (optional; email required), FACEBOOK /
  TWITTER (optional / optional), ACCOUNT (optional; Glympse user id required), GROUP (optional; group id or name
  required), SHARE (app name; app signature required), APP (app name; addressee id optional), CLIPBOARD (blank),
  LINK (app specific, optional)
- Delivery: the server sends EMAIL, social; SMS/LINK/CLIPBOARD/SHARE are client
  delivered: wait for INVITE_STATE_NEEDTOSEND, call initiateClientSideSend (optional), deliver the URL, then
  completeClientSideSend:(success)
- Ticket lifetime: sendTicket makes the ticket ADDING and registers it in the history manager. Minimum duration 10 s;
  default maximum 4 h (getConfig().getMaximumTicketDuration). A ticket can be sent only once

## 8. Config (persisted) and location
- GlyConfig: setExpireOnArrival: (EXPIRE_ON_ARRIVAL_NONE | NOTIFY (default) | AUTO), allowSpeedSharing:,
  allowLocationSharing:, setDeleteAfterComplete:, getMaximumTicketDuration, getMaximumNicknameLength, setDiagnosticDataEnabled:,
  setMetricDirections:, getDeviceId, save
- GlyLocationManager: getLocation, startLocation / stopLocation:, getLocationState (GlyCoreConstants LOCATION_STATE_
  NOT_DETERMINED=1, DENIED=2, ACQUIRED=3, ERROR=4), getLocationPermission (LOCATION_PERMISSION_ UNKNOWN=0, DISABLED=1,
  WHILE_IN_USE=2, ALWAYS=3), getLocationAccuracyAuthorization (LOCATION_ACCURACY_AUTH_FULL=0, REDUCED=1; reduced
  accuracy is possible from iOS 14)
- ETA: default ETA_MODE_EXTERNAL (you call updateEta: / updateRoute:); ETA_MODE_INTERNAL needs a destination.
  Expire on arrival fires PLATFORM_TICKET_ARRIVED and TICKET_ARRIVED

## 9. Constants (GlyGlympseConstants)
- INVITE_TYPE_*: UNKNOWN=0, ACCOUNT=1, EMAIL=2, SMS=3, TWITTER=4, FACEBOOK=5, LINK=6, GROUP=7, SHARE=8, CLIPBOARD=9,
  EVERNOTE=10, APP=11
- INVITE_STATE_*: NONE=0, SERVERSENDING=1, CLIENTSENDING=2, NEEDTOSEND=3, SUCCEEDED=4, DELETING=5, DELETED=6,
  FAILED_TO_CREATE=7, FAILED_TO_SEND=8, FAILED_TO_DELETE=9
- INVITE_MODE_*: DEFAULT=0 (view automatically), PROMPT_BEFORE_VIEWING=1, ACTIVATE_USER=2 (combine with DEFAULT:
  starts tracking). INVITE_ASPECT_*: UNKNOWN, TICKET, REQUEST, CARD
- TICKET_STATE_*: NONE, ADDING, INVALID, ACTIVE, EXPIRING, EXPIRED, DELETING, DELETED, FAILED_TO_CREATE, CANCELLED

## 10. Flows with exact order
A. First run: createGlympse -> add listener -> exempt(fromConsent:) (or consent UI + grantConsent) -> start -> STARTED,
   FIRST_LAUNCH -> ACCOUNT_CREATED -> LOGIN_SUCCEEDED -> SYNCED. Relaunch: STARTED -> LOGIN_SUCCEEDED -> SYNCED.
B. Send: SYNCED -> createTicket -> createInvite -> add(invite) -> add(listener) -> send(ticket) -> TICKET_CREATED ->
   TICKET_INVITE_CREATED / _SENT -> (viewers: INVITE_UPDATED) -> modify/extend/expire -> TICKET_EXPIRED -> TICKET_COMPLETED.
C. View: decodeInvite(code, DEFAULT | ACTIVATE_USER) -> PLATFORM_USER_ADDED -> USER_ACTIVE_TICKET_CHANGED -> ticket
   events. With DEFAULT only, call getUserManager().startTracking(user). With PROMPT_BEFORE_VIEWING:
   PLATFORM_INVITE_TICKET -> viewTicket(userTicket) -> startTracking(user).
D. Active state: app active setActive(true); background setActive(false); one pair per transition; setActive(true)
   again after start if the app is already active.
E. Reset: stop -> logout -> new instance -> flow A (FIRST_LAUNCH again).
F. Push: request authorization -> registerForRemoteNotifications (every launch) -> APNs token (hex string) -> hold it
   until the platform has started -> registerDeviceToken. Remote notification -> userInfo["payload"] (String) ->
   handleRemoteNotification (platform must be started) -> completion handler.

## 11. Capabilities matrix (iOS)
- Info.plist: NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription, NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescription, optional legacy
  NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription (makes the SDK ask for Always), NSMotionUsageDescription (activity recognition)
- UIBackgroundModes: location, remote-notification
- Entitlement: aps-environment (development / production)
- If location status is undetermined when the SDK first starts location, the SDK prompts itself (Always if
  NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription is present, else When In Use if NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription is)
- The anonymous account is stored in the Keychain; a reinstall creates a new account
